releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = monitoring; enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring. The backend-status check only exists under v1, so these feature-scoped metrics are one-armed (control emits no events). The frontend service has no OpenTelemetry or LaunchDarkly observability SDK installed and the project has no autogenerated otel* metrics, so track() is the only valid guardrail backing here.
